description: Default terrain height settings (plan m-teren-vyska), exported by the World Lab. One level 0–9 per slider of its Terrain height section; src/game/terrainHeight.js turns them into the height map and keeps the same levels in DEFAULT_HEIGHT_LEVELS (the game does not import art/; a test keeps both equal). The owner proposes new values with "Propose as default" in the World Lab (page database heightDefaults/proposal) or exports this file from there.
